paragraphs.text: Fulmart's Fort is a jumble of rocks 16 leagues south of the port of Buzzard's Bay , part of western Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria .

The fort lies on a cliff at the edge of Witch's Weir , the southern arm of the bay. Along the outside of the fort, a swift river tumbles into the ocean, and by following this river upstream, one can reach the forest of Arboria .
